name: Expedition A3
summary: A full-size AgiBot built light — 55 kg at 173 cm, in magnesium, titanium and TPU — for a power-to-weight ratio of 0.218 kW/kg. That budget buys aerial kicks and mid-air steps in its martial-arts demos, a waist that rotates and bends like a human torso rather than a rigid block, ten hours of runtime and a ten-second hot battery swap.
